entry.name: CTR360
entry.author: dougieprishpreed
entry.sentence: The PC port of a classic PlayStation kart racer, at 1280x720 and up to 60 fps.
entry.changes: Converts your disc image on the console, so no PC is needed; fixes the freezes at Citadel City's boss and at the end of split-screen races; Back + Start goes to the dashboard.
